title: $\otimes^{\mathrm L}$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}$
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme of the setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], and let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring such that
the derived tensor product $-\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\Lambda_X}-$ of [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]
carries pairs of bounded constructible complexes to bounded constructible complexes. By
[lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves] this holds for $\Lambda=\underline{\cO}_E,\underline E$ with $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite
subextension of the fixed $\Qlb$ ([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]), and for
$\Lambda=\underline{\Qlb}$ ([sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]).
The derived tensor product

$$
-\otimes^{\mathrm L}-\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)\times D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)\to D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)
$$

is its restriction in both variables. For fixed $K\in D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)$, the functor $K\otimes^{\mathrm L}-$ commutes
with the inclusions.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: put D = D(Mod_{Λ_X}), P = bounded constructible, C = P.FullSubcategory × P.FullSubcategory, and F = (P.ι.prod P.ι) ⋙ T for the uncurried ambient derived tensor functor T of sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom; define the restriction by P.lift F (fun KL => h KL.1.property KL.2.property), where h is the preservation hypothesis in the item. The compatibility clause is CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.liftCompιIso, same file line 165, specialized to F_K = P.ι ⋙ T(K,-); its components are identities. Lines 167 and 170 give literal equality on underlying objects and morphisms. The coefficient examples invoke the existing node lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves, not a new Mathlib preservation assertion.
